eyebrow: One playground, not a new one every time

steps.label: Reuse the org from Lesson 3
steps.sub: unless you have a real reason not to — fragmentation costs you more than a messy org does

steps.label: Give it a name you'll recognize
steps.sub: something like "LTV Training Org," not the random default

steps.label: Log in every few weeks
steps.sub: playgrounds can go stale with long inactivity — a standing calendar reminder helps

caption: Back on Hands-On Orgs, Rename updates the label without touching the org's actual username — safe to do any time, including well after creation.

eyebrow: Stock it with tools you'll reuse
caption: Trailhead Playgrounds include an "Install a Package" tool for pasting in a package ID directly — useful for keeping one org stocked with apps you'll return to across courses.
Package installs ask where to install: your permanent playground acts as the "production" choice here — there's no separate sandbox tier for a personal training org.

subtitle: Keeping a permanent org from turning into chaos.
